title: Pickleball Christmas Sweatshirt, Merry Dinkmas Shirt, Funny Holiday Gift for Pickleball Player
description:
Wish your favourite pickleball player a very Merry Dinkmas. A string of holiday lights, a Santa-hatted pickleball and a joke only players will get.

Who it's for:
- Pickleball players who need a festive layer for the courts
- Anyone shopping for a Christmas or Secret Santa gift for a pickleball fan
- Clubs and doubles groups planning a holiday round-robin

About the design:
Bold cream lettering and a gold script 'Merry' on a dark garment, with a cheeky 'From the kitchen to the chimney' line underneath. Clean, flat colours for a crisp print.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Merry Dinkmas holiday design with a string of lights and a Santa-hatted pickleball on a black sweatshirt.
